LanguageData.VoidDeleter_ToggleDesc: Enable or disable the Void Deleter. When disabled it will not process any designations even if powered.
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_SelectAreaDesc: Choose which area this Void Deleter monitors for deconstruction, mining, floor and foundation removal designations (current: {0}).
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_OutputModeDesc: Toggle where products are placed after deconstruction, mining or floor/foundation removal. Current mode: {0}. Click to switch.
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_FinishAllDesc: Immediately finish all pending designations (respects selected area).
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_CleanFilthDesc: Immediately clean all filth in the selected area (cleans entire map if no area is selected).
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_ConfirmCleanFilth: Are you sure you want to clean all filth in the area?
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_ConfirmFinishAll: Are you sure you want to finish all pending tasks in the area?
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_CleanGasDesc: Immediately clean all gas (RotStink, ToxGas, Smoke, etc.) in the selected area. Cleans entire map if no area is selected.
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_ConfirmCleanGas: Are you sure you want to clean all gas in the area?
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_CleanCorpsesDesc: Immediately clean all corpses in the selected area that are not in a valid storage. Cleans all scattered corpses on the map if no area is selected.
LanguageData.VoidDeleter_ConfirmCleanCorpses: Are you sure you want to clean all corpses in the area that are not in storage? (This action is irreversible!)
